components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A clear command with a stable mobile touch target.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--accent-blue); color: var(--bg-primary); font: 600 0.75rem var(--font-sans); transition: filter 160ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary command used in compact operational toolbars.
components.css: .ds-button-ghost { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--control-boundary); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary); font: 600 0.75rem var(--font-sans); transition: color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease; } .ds-button-ghost:hover { color: var(--text-primary); background: var(--bg-card-hover); } .ds-button-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Compact ticker search with a visible edge in both themes.
components.css: .ds-search { min-height: 44px; width: 180px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--control-boundary); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--control-bg); color: var(--text-primary); font: 500 0.75rem var(--font-mono); } .ds-search::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-blue); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--accent-blue); }

components.name: Selected Chip
components.description: Selected state for filters and segmented controls.
components.css: .ds-chip-selected { display: inline-flex; min-height: 28px; align-items: center; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-chip); background: var(--control-selected-bg); color: var(--control-selected-text); font: 600 0.75rem var(--font-sans); }

components.name: Data Panel
components.description: Flat repeated surface for dense market information.
components.html:
Signal analysis

Evidence remains readable without decorative depth.
components.css: .ds-data-panel { padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); border-radius: var(--radius-panel); background: var(--card-bg); color: var(--text-primary); font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 var(--font-sans); } .ds-data-panel strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-data-panel p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-secondary); }

components.name: Desktop Navigation
components.description: Persistent route rail with an icon-and-label active state.
components.html: Command CenterPillars
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; min-height: 52px; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--glass-border); background: var(--glass-bg-strong); } .ds-nav-item { min-height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-control); color: var(--text-secondary); text-decoration: none; font: 600 0.8rem var(--font-sans); } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--text-primary); background: var(--bg-card-hover); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-blue); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item-active { color: var(--accent-blue); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-blue) 13%, transparent); }

narrative.overview: Stock-TimeFM is a quiet operational instrument built for repeated scanning, comparison, and investigation. Neutral, high-contrast surfaces preserve distinct roles for price movement, risk state, human evidence, and interactive focus. Density is intentional on desktop; progressive disclosure carries the same workflows to a 320px phone.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained graphite and neutral-white surfaces with one interaction accent.
Dense desktop master/detail and touch-native mobile list/detail.
Semantic color backed by text, icons, and labels.
Solid repeated panels; blur only on persistent navigation and sticky context.
Stable dimensions, tabular numerics, visible focus, and reduced motion.

rules.name: The Semantic Rarity Rule
rules.body: Action blue marks selection and action only. Green and red never decorate; they always communicate a signed or health state.

rules.name: The Instrument Type Rule
rules.body: Numeric information uses the mono role and aligned figures; headings never scale with viewport width or use negative letter spacing.

rules.name: The Flat Data Rule
rules.body: Repeated data panels do not use backdrop blur or resting shadows. Blur belongs only to persistent chrome with content moving beneath it.

dos: Do keep all primary mobile controls at least 44px and test from 320px portrait upward.
Do contain wide tables and tapes inside their workspace scroller rather than allowing viewport overflow.
Do use safe-area insets for the mobile top and bottom chrome.
Do preserve both themes through the existing compatibility tokens.
Do pair semantic color with a label, number sign, icon, or status text.
Do use list-to-detail navigation on phones and simultaneous master/detail on desktop.
donts: Don't make a marketing site or oversized hero experience.
Don't make a generic SaaS card mosaic.
Don't make a decorative imitation of a financial terminal.
Don't scale a desktop table down until it technically fits a phone.
Don't add live-trading or order-entry controls.
Don't use decorative glass excess, backdrop blur on repeated cards, wide resting shadows, gradient text, or ornamental animation.
Don't use green or red as decoration, or rely on color as the only carrier of meaning.
Don't use side-stripe borders thicker than 1px, oversized rounded panels, or nested card framing.
